title: "Treatment Mapping DashBoard"
author: "cody tengan"
format: dashboard
---

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor) 
library(arrow) # lets us read/write parquet and feather files
library(sf) # "simple features" for spatial data
library(urbnmapr) # access to US state/country shapefiles for mapping
library(naniar) # tools for exploring and visualizing missing data
library(ggiraph) # makes ggplot charts interactive
options(scipen = 99) # turns off scientific notation

```

```{r echo=FALSE}

teds_d <- read_parquet(here("teds_d_clean.parquet"))

teds_d_map <- ggplot(data = teds_d) +
  geom_sf_interactive(
    aes(
      geometry = stfips,
      fill = freq1_d,
      tooltip = paste("State FIPS:", stfips)
    ),
    color = "white",
    size = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(fill = "Frequency at discharge") +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal()


girafe(ggobj = teds_d_map)



```

```{r echo=FALSE}

percent_completed_by_state <- teds_d %>%
  group_by(stfips) %>% 
  summarize(
    total_cases = n(),
    completed_cases = sum(reason == "Treatment completed", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    percentage_completed = (completed_cases / total_cases) * 100,
    state_fips = sprintf("%02d", stfips)   # FIXED HERE
  )

states_map <- get_urbn_map(map = "states", sf = TRUE)

percent_completed_by_state_map <- full_join(
  percent_completed_by_state,
  states_map,
  by = "state_fips"
)

# Static map
ggplot(percent_completed_by_state_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(geometry = geometry, fill = percentage_completed),
    color = "#ffffff", size = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(fill = "% of Completed Treatment Episodes") +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal()

# Interactive map
completed_treatment_map_int <- ggplot(percent_completed_by_state_map) +
  geom_sf_interactive(
    aes(
      geometry = geometry,
      fill = percentage_completed,
      tooltip = paste(
        "State:", state_abbv,
        "<br>State FIPS:", stfips,
        "<br>Completed:", round(percentage_completed, 2), "%"
      )
    ),
    color = "#ffffff",
    size = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(fill = "% of Completed Treatment Episodes") +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal()

# Create bins
percent_completed_by_state_map <- percent_completed_by_state_map %>% 
  mutate(
    percentage_bin = cut(
      percentage_completed,
      breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40,50,60,70,80),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    percentage_bin = fct_explicit_na(percentage_bin, na_level = "no data")
  )

```

```{r echo=FALSE}

percent_complete_binned_int <- ggplot(percent_completed_by_state_map) +
  geom_sf_interactive(
    aes(
      geometry = geometry,
      fill = percentage_bin,
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>State FIPS:</b> ", stfips,
        "<br><b>Completed:</b> ", round(percentage_completed, 1), "%"
      )
    ),
    color = "#ffffff",
    size = 0.25
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "% of Completed Treatment Episodes",
    title = "Completed Treatment Episodes by State",
    subtitle = "TEDS-D Dataset (SAMHSA)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", direction = -1) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 4)
  )

girafe(ggobj = percent_complete_binned_int)

```

ggplot(teds_d, aes(x = freq1_d)) +

ggplot(teds_d, aes(x = los)) +
